title: Charlie Johnson at Smalls and the film Smash Your Baggage
summary: After Snowden's band folded Roy stayed with Charlie Johnson, and they discuss the film Smash Your Baggage.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Then, after that thing folded... Then I went back with Charlie Johnson.
You stayed when Snowden got fired.
You made that movie with Snowden, right?
Smash Your Baggage. That's with the waiters and things, yeah.
I've seen it. Of course, they've got this whole Grand Central setting, and the redcaps and all. But is that pretty authentic in what went on in the clubs...?

Well, the waiters were in the... They didn't worry about... They had just a waiter's thing going. You know, the waiter in the Eton(?) jacket, not the Pullman caps or nothing like that, you know, like porters. It was
pretty... Except we didn't get into that standing around like we was doing, you know. You sit down and play. But we played then, you know.
